title: [Lean] Discover and check compact dictionary keys from original bytes
body:
Author-checked contextual kappa = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918. These reusable theorems neither use nor change kappa and do not prove the full multiplication theorem.

## Completed reusable chunk

Five exact accepted modules discover ordered key candidates from the original artifact bytes and execute the existing complete compact-dictionary checker. Executable inputs are artifact bytes, a selected index and chart update/coefficient functions; neither keys nor column arrays are supplied.

QuoteTokenScan proves exact alternating byte regions and completeness for the checked hex-key/compact-Nat flat layout. AsciiUtf8RoundTrip proves logical UTF-8 reconstruction for ASCII. HexKeyUtf8RoundTrip derives that premise from the actual checked byte policy. DiscoveredCompactObject feeds scanned/decoded keys into the unchanged complete-layout checker. DiscoveredCompactCompleteness removes the separate token-decoding premise without changing executable checks.

## Coverage boundaries

Finite coverage: parameterized finite byte arrays, field lists and binary dimensions; no selected artifact census or literal dataset execution is claimed in this package.

Conditional-interface coverage: successful execution retains ordered named columns and bounds, complete original byte equality, restricted independent column operator and both inverse directions. Restricted completeness still requires the actual original whole-artifact and fragment Json.parse equations and the existing chart Candidate conditions. Scanning alone is not a general JSON parser.

Full-theorem coverage: escaped/nested JSON, parser internal source spans, runtime extern refinement, external artifact/digest authentication, complex phases, physical execution/cost, recursive all-size bound and full multiplication/runtime remain separate.

## Evidence and reuse

Five unchanged independently accepted sources total 37,321 bytes; ten changed files. They reuse twenty-four immutable public prerequisites, including PR1993, without copying those modules. ACCEPTANCE.json records twenty-two complete standard-axiom probes and nine full printed types. Only fixed alphabet/mask facts use ordinary closed decide checks. Historical preparation comments are preserved and qualified by the additive acceptance record.

REPRODUCTION.md gives bounded serial commands for an existing Lean 4.21.0/Mathlib installation and exact source hashes. No proof replay, dependency installation or archive rebuild was performed for publication. Local kernel acceptance, later executable tests and exact-head CI are distinct.

The directly author-checked historical source context feb4dd177862175ea61e27f1cda7c6d124d39b55 is retained. Candidate parent is 6aff82d6d346fb2238d061ef45066b82d48a9b67; exact scoped continuity preserves the five critical selected scientific inputs and source-matched kappa. This base was adopted at the natural chunk boundary without rebuilding unchanged proofs.

Bounded overlap: PR1993 requires ordered keys; this chunk derives them from the same actual bytes and discharges token reconstruction from checked key policy. Prior parser, compact-column and restricted certificate sources remain imports. Exact module searches found no duplicate PR; no global novelty claim. See OVERLAP.md and the manifest for prior sources and attribution. James Chang with OpenAI assistance; existing Lean/Mathlib, Jeremy Kothe T16/PR514, Rohan Arun PR1094 and upstream notices are preserved.

Submission context: five critical scientific inputs freshly match at c4e06b3822987b4272c70ff82ae1c84773ee4426; exact fork head 6f2a51b4d3ed03f139de8d73bc6849f6447d2305. This scoped source check is not acceptance of unrelated new packages.
